# Test data

- `fixtures/spec-data`, `fixtures/spec-envelope`: copies of `examples/valid/release/v1/` and `examples/valid/release/envelope/v1/` of [angelia-dev/spec](https://github.com/angelia-dev/spec), unchanged.
- `fixtures/spec-invalid`: copies of the invalid examples this action's shape checks must reject (`examples/invalid/release/v1/` and `.../envelope/v1/`, prefixed `data-` and `envelope-`). The action does not run the full JSON Schema; the spec repository's CI does.
- Taken from spec commit `da75b65e94b9e9f0341bd89ea64811ef58f1ae09` (spec 0.10.0). Refresh them when the release schema changes.
- `fixtures/dispatch`: synthetic GitHub event files (`GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` content) for `repository_dispatch` and `workflow_dispatch`, generated by `test/gen-dispatch-fixtures.sh` with the mapping of Angelia's github-dispatch sink (`internal/sink/githubdispatch/githubdispatch.go`, `clientPayload`). Do not edit them by hand. `test/run.sh` uses them (the `script` job of `test.yml` runs it). A workflow step cannot override the runner's `GITHUB_EVENT_*` variables, so the real action is not replayed against them.
- `expected.tsv`: the expected outputs per fixture, written by hand.
